LanguageData.UP_Intro: Fixes for the vanilla game in the RimWorld 1.7 beta until Ludeon fixes them. Written for game build {0} (you run {1}). When an update changes the game code a fix relies on, that fix pauses itself – most likely Ludeon fixed it. Changes need a restart to switch a fix ON; switching OFF works at once.
LanguageData.UP_wind: Plant wind sway: once per frame instead of every tick
LanguageData.UP_wind_Desc: The game wrote the sway value into every plant material on every simulation tick, although you only see it once per drawn frame. At speed 3 and 4 that is many locked GPU writes per frame for nothing. Plants sway exactly the same.
LanguageData.UP_freeze: Freezing and melting (Odyssey): cheap checks first
LanguageData.UP_freeze_Desc: 38 random cells a tick looked up temperature and room before checking whether the cell is water at all – even on tropical maps. Same rules and the same random rolls, just in a cheaper order.
LanguageData.UP_gas_Desc: After the first gas on a map (one rotting corpse is enough) about 2 900 cells were checked every tick, almost all of them empty. Empty cells are skipped now – the game did nothing with them anyway.
LanguageData.UP_sealed_Desc: Every GetComp call asked "is this type sealed?" through a global lock – thousands of times a tick. Same answer, lock-free.
LanguageData.UP_world: World map settlements: no empty work
LanguageData.UP_world_Desc: Every tick each settlement without a map (often 240+) collected its contents just to find the trader stock, which never ticks. Plain settlements now stop after their own tick. Steps aside automatically if another mod changes what settlements hold.
LanguageData.UP_health: Health tick: skip pawns without injuries or conditions
LanguageData.UP_health_Desc: Pawns with no hediffs at all still copied an empty list every tick. Now they skip it.
LanguageData.UP_steal: Raids: fast "what can I steal" check
LanguageData.UP_steal_Desc: Every 2 s each raider priced every tree and rock chunk near it, and each price searched through ALL recipes of the game (2 000+ with many mods). The answer never changes, so it is remembered. Fixes stutter while big raids walk in. Steps aside if another mod changes this calculation.
LanguageData.UP_caravan: Caravan window: no crash with vehicles
LanguageData.UP_caravan_Desc: Picking medicine for a pawn without player settings (vehicles and other modded pawns) threw an error every frame and broke the Form caravan window. Such pawns now just get no medicine.
LanguageData.UP_wanderers: "Create new wanderers" with a colonist in an ancient casket
LanguageData.UP_wanderers_Desc: When the last colonist lay in an ancient cryptosleep casket, the game declared game over but never offered new wanderers. A colonist in a casket that is not yours no longer blocks the offer.
